verified_key_information_units.information: Eleving Group achieved all-time best financial performance in 2024 with EUR 29.6 mln net profit (21% YoY increase), EUR 216.6 mln revenue (+15% YoY), EUR 89.8 mln EBITDA (+10% YoY), and EUR 371.2 mln net loan portfolio (+16% YoY).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report '2024 at a glance'; Consolidated statements of profit and loss; CEO keynote

candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue for the reporting period reached EUR 216.6 million, representing an increase of nearly 15 percent compared to EUR 189.3 million in 2023.
The Group reported an adjusted EBITDA of EUR 89.8 million, marking an increase of over 16 percent compared to EUR 77.5 million in the previous year.
Net profit for the period reached an all-time high of EUR 29.6 million, up almost 21 percent from EUR 24.5 million in 2023.
The vehicle and consumer financing net portfolio expanded by 16 percent to EUR 371.2 million as of December 31, 2024, compared to EUR 320.3 million at the end of 2023.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key year-over-year improvements included a 29.3% capitalization ratio (vs 26.1% in 2023), 2.4 interest coverage ratio (vs 2.3), and reduced net leverage to 3.3x (from 3.7x).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report financial highlights; Note 48 Alternative Performance Measures

candidate_sentences.text: The capitalization ratio improved to 29.3 percent from 26.1 percent in 2023, the interest coverage ratio was 2.4 compared to 2.3 in the prior year, and net leverage improved to 3.3 from 3.7.

verified_key_information_units.information: Major performance drivers were organic growth in Europe/Africa, successful integration of Sub-Saharan operations (tripling regional portfolio), digital transformation (doubled applications, new self-service platform), and enhanced risk management improving portfolio quality.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO keynote; Management report operations section

candidate_sentences.text: Total loan issuance volumes increased by 26.8 percent to EUR 368.6 million, up from EUR 290.6 million in the previous year, driven by organic demand, digital transformation efforts, and expanded sales channels.
Operationally, the Group completed the integration of Sub-Saharan operations acquired in 2023, tripling the combined portfolio size across its three main markets in the region.
Furthermore, the Group advanced its sustainability agenda by financing nearly 2,000 electric motorcycles in Eastern Africa, achieving its 2025 environmental target a full year ahead of schedule.
Portfolio asset quality improved year-over-year, evidenced by a reduction in non-performing loan rates to 6.1 percent for vehicle finance and 4.3 percent for consumer finance.

verified_key_information_units.information: Business segments showed vehicle finance (67% of portfolio: 45% traditional, 20% flexible/subscription) and consumer finance (33%: Kredo, Tigo, etc.), with key growth in East Africa (e-motorcycles), Romania, Uganda, and Albania offsetting exits from Balkan/Belarus.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report segments; Sustainability statement portfolio balance; Note 19 discontinued operations

verified_key_information_units.information: Capital structure transformed via October 2024 IPO raising EUR 29.0 mln equity (largest in Nasdaq Riga history), used to repay subordinated bonds and high-cost Mintos loans, while expanding local currency funding (Kenya +30%, Botswana notes).

candidate_sentences.text: A defining milestone of the reporting period was the successful initial public offering on Nasdaq Riga and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2024, which secured EUR 29.0 million in equity proceeds and strengthened the Group's capital base.
Total equity significantly increased to EUR 108.1 million at the end of 2024, compared to EUR 65.4 million at the end of 2023.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic priorities include deepening existing markets, broadening product portfolio (e.g., electric motorcycle financing surpassing 2025 targets), geographic expansion, and developing ESG strategy for 2026-2031 with climate neutrality targets for HQ operations.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K5, and K6 are fully represented with supporting sentences covering all core material meanings. K4 is missing entirely - no information about business segment composition, regional growth offsets, or market exits. K7 is missing - no mention of post-reporting period events (March 2025 bond tap or North Macedonia tax refund). While most high-importance criteria are covered, the absence of K4 (segment structure and geographic strategy) and K7 (liquidity impacts) prevents a 'Yes' rating. The score reflects strong coverage of performance metrics, capital structure, and strategic drivers, but notable gaps in segment details and recent events.

There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. The summary flows logically from revenue and profitability metrics to operational achievements, portfolio growth, asset quality improvements, capital structure changes, and key milestones. Adjustments for one-off items (S5-S6) are clearly explained and consistently applied.
